**Design-off measurement: two harnesses, same brief — complementary blind spots (the n>1 harness argument) — Track H (#266)**

**What**: Ran a controlled design-off — identical brief (design the automated external reviewer protocol), two harnesses (Claude Code, Antigravity) working in isolation, no cross-reading. Verdict: SYNTHESIS (Claude skeleton + 3 Antigravity transplants + 3 documented rejections). Became issue #266.

**TRACK LETTER — CORRECTED: it is Track H, not Track G and not Track R.** The kickoff called it "Track G", but `docs/inbox/PLAN-adapters-v3.md:418` already assigns G to `brain:metrics` (CP-G1). Letters A–G are taken; H is the first free letter in order. Ruled Track H, phases H0–H2, recorded as a PLAN-DEVIATION in the issue body. (An earlier version of this observation said "Track R" — that was wrong and is now superseded.)

This is the THIRD track-letter churn in a week (Distribution→D, then G collision, then this correction), which re-proves [[track-letters-uncontrolled-namespace]]: the durable fix is a canonical letter→name→status table in the plan, where opening a track means taking the next free letter AND registering it in the same act.

**Why (the meta-measurement — the point of the experiment)**: two harnesses, same brief, complementary blind spots. Claude was **structural-governmental**: it found the authorization hazard by reading the gates (`brain:protect` sets `required_approving_review_count: 1`; L6 counts any non-author APPROVE — so a reviewer agent running `gh pr review --approve` would become a merge authorizer), and produced the three structural locks (COMMENT-state verdicts, a verb with no approve code path, `governance.approvalActors`). Antigravity was **operational-concrete**: TDD-RED validation by reversion, real CI hosting (`reviewer.yml` + per-PR concurrency mutex), cross-PR sequencing board.

Neither harness found what the other found. The union covered what neither covered alone. **This is the sharpest empirical argument we have for n>1 harnesses** — not a preference, a measurement.

**Where**: issue #266. Both source documents preserved unmodified as the record of the experiment: `design-docs/reviewer-protocol-claude-code.md` (15,210 B) and `design-docs/reviewer-protocol-antigravity.md` (8,296 B), currently untracked in the main worktree, durably backed up at `~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/`. They get committed together, as-is, on the Track H branch.

**Learned**: the Antigravity doc was originally written inside the `brain-issue-260` worktree, which is slated for post-merge cleanup after #261 — deliverables written inside a disposable worktree are one `git worktree remove` away from being lost. Rescued before cleanup. Worktree-local untracked files are not a storage location.

**Status**: #266 is OPEN with the full synthesis in its body (H0/H1/H2 scope, transplants, rejections, failure modes, acceptance). It carries `type:feature` but NOT `status:approved` — human approval is the L5 gate that must precede any branch.
